# PostgreSQL features

## MERGE (PostgreSQL 17+ for `returning`)

```ts
const { rows } = await Stock.merge({
  source: [
    { sku: 'a', qty: 3 },
    { sku: 'n', qty: 9 },
  ],
  on: { sku: col('source.sku') },
  whenMatched: { update: { qty: col('source.qty') } },
  whenNotMatched: { insert: true },
  whenNotMatchedBySource: { update: { status: 'retired' } },
  returning: true,
});
const actions = rows.map(({ action, instance }) => `${action} ${String(instance.get('sku'))}`);
// actions (in any order): 'UPDATE a', 'INSERT n', 'UPDATE b' (b is retired)
```

## RETURNING old values (PostgreSQL 18+)

```ts
const [, changed = []] = await Stock.update(
  { qty: literal('qty + 10') },
  { where: { sku: 'a' }, returning: true, returningOld: true },
);
const [stock] = changed;
// stock.get('qty') === 11, stock.oldValues === { id: 1, sku: 'a', qty: 1 }
```

## Subqueries, EXISTS, DISTINCT ON, window functions

```ts
const authors = await User.findAll({
  where: {
    id: { [Op.in]: Post.subquery({ attributes: ['UserId'], where: { published: true } }) },
  },
  order: [['id', 'ASC']],
});

const counted = await User.findAll({
  attributes: [
    'name',
    [
      Post.subquery({
        attributes: [[fn('count', col('Post.id')), 'n']],
        where: { UserId: col('User.id') },
      }),
      'postCount',
    ],
  ],
  order: [['id', 'ASC']],
  raw: true,
});
// counted: [{ name: 'ann', postCount: '2' }, { name: 'bob', postCount: '2' }, { name: 'cid', postCount: '0' }]
```

```ts
const postsOf = (extra: object) =>
  Post.subquery({ attributes: ['id'], where: { UserId: col('User.id'), ...extra } });

const highRanked = await User.findAll({ where: exists(postsOf({ rank: { [Op.gte]: 5 } })) });
const silent = await User.findAll({ where: notExists(postsOf({})) });
// highRanked: bob; silent: cid
```

```ts
const topPerUser = await Post.findAll({
  distinctOn: ['UserId'],
  order: [
    ['UserId', 'ASC'],
    ['rank', 'DESC'],
  ],
});
// topPerUser: a1, b2
```

```ts
const ranked = await Post.findAll({
  attributes: [
    'title',
    [
      over(fn('row_number'), { partitionBy: ['UserId'], orderBy: [['rank', 'DESC']] }),
      'position',
    ],
  ],
  order: [['title', 'ASC']],
  raw: true,
});
// ranked: a1 → '1', a2 → '2', b1 → '2', b2 → '1'
```

## CTEs and keyset pagination

```ts
const rootChildren = await Category.count({
  with: {
    roots: {
      query: Category.subquery({ attributes: ['id'], where: { parentId: null } }),
      materialized: true,
    },
  },
  where: {
    parentId: { [Op.in]: Category.subquery({ attributes: ['id'], source: 'roots' }) },
  },
});
// rootChildren === 2
```

```ts
const subtree = await Category.findAll({
  with: {
    tree: {
      query: Category.subquery({ where: { name: 'a' } }),
      recursive: Category.subquery({
        where: { parentId: col('tree.id') },
        from: { tree: 'tree' },
      }),
    },
  },
  source: 'tree',
  order: [['id', 'ASC']],
});
// subtree: a, a1, a1x — Category instances read from the CTE
```

```ts
const nextPage = await Post.findAll({
  where: where(tuple(col('rank'), col('id')), Op.lt, tuple(3, 1)),
  order: [
    ['rank', 'DESC'],
    ['id', 'DESC'],
  ],
  limit: 10,
});
// nextPage: b1, a2 — rows after (rank 3, id 1) in (rank DESC, id DESC) order
```

```ts
const seen: string[] = [];
for await (const post of Post.findEach({ order: [['id', 'ASC']] }, { batchSize: 2 })) {
  seen.push(String(post.get('title')));
}
// seen: a1, a2, b1, b2 — fetched two rows at a time through a server-side cursor
```

## Not supported

Source of truth: <https://tormozz48.github.io/postgrelize/postgresql-coverage>. Missing features (use `sequelize.query()` raw SQL or `literal()`):

- **SELECT clauses**: ONLY (table inheritance)
- **Data types**: composite types; pg_lsn, txid_snapshot and other system types; PostGIS geometry / geography
- **DDL (sync and QueryInterface)**: Declarative partitioning (PARTITION BY / PARTITION OF / ATTACH); Rules (CREATE RULE)
- **Session features**: Two-phase commit (PREPARE TRANSACTION)
- **Out of scope**: Roles, GRANT / REVOKE, default privileges; Replication setup (publications, subscriptions, slots, logical decoding); Tablespaces; VACUUM, ANALYZE, REINDEX, CLUSTER, pg_stat views; Procedural languages (PL/pgSQL bodies, DO blocks, procedures); Extension internals (writing or configuring extensions); Foreign data wrappers and foreign tables; Server configuration (ALTER SYSTEM, pg_hba.conf, event triggers)
